title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy’s DP World Partnership
items.text: Rory McIlroy secured a multi-year deal with DP World to travel with custom fitness and recovery trailers, showcasing his offseason dedication to performance.

items.headline: Garcia Leaves LIV for DP World Tour
items.text: Sergio Garcia announced departure from LIV Golf to rejoin the DP World Tour in 2027, keeping his options open for a PGA Tour return and Ryder Cup hopes.

items.headline: Ryu Withdraws From Maybank Classic
items.text: Two-time major leader Haeran Ryu withdrew ahead of the opening round at the LPGA Tour's Maybank Classic on Thursday.
